proves: The declared release metadata, skills, implementation surfaces, tests, trust inventory, CI gates, and production evidence are present and mutually consistent in this checkout.
The modular upstream modeling kernel and the Sculpt DNA compatibility, family-generation, evidence, host-integration, and optional React Three Fiber runtime layers coexist in this release.
Every committed Python script is declared in a network-disabled executable policy, and one offline proof command runs the policy, capability, first-clone, compile, contract, and release gates.
The published Proof Lab reads only committed capability evidence and the machine-readable result produced by that same proof command.
doesNotProve: GitHub stars, clone counts, or social reach are not treated as evidence of software quality.
Feature breadth and passing contracts do not by themselves prove better visual output than another project.
A visual-quality superiority claim requires the same references, budgets, runtime constraints, raw outputs, and blinded review protocol documented in docs/FAIR_COMPARISON_PROTOCOL.md.

claims.statement: New reconstructions can use a v4 root manifest, independently validated modules, adaptive pass planning, and content/interface-hash reuse.
Validation and generation share a procedural geometry registry covering compound, swept, lofted, fitted, branched, scattered, instanced, modified, sculpted, and specialized surface systems.

Reference-derived PBR extraction accepts validated pixel or normalized material regions and records source dimensions, source SHA-256, resolved crop identity, suitability diagnostics, and patch history without changing the no-crop path.
The adaptive v3.1/v4 workflow and the published Sculpt DNA schema-v2 production lane are dispatched explicitly instead of silently weakening either contract.
Named semantic controls, invariant checks, deterministic seeds, Coverage Curator selection, and a base-plus-variant regression matrix form one reproducible asset-family pipeline.
Multi-view comparisons, content hashes, review precedence, critical-feature vetoes, generated-runtime receipts, and production release gates bind acceptance to the implementation that produced it.
Generated models carry action-ready hierarchy contracts and can be checked against immutable standalone and host renderer snapshots before promotion.

An optional React Three Fiber adapter mounts plain or structured Sculpt DNA factories, forwards frame updates, exposes action-ready runtime maps and stats, rebuilds on canonical option changes, and performs StrictMode-safe exact-once cleanup without changing the plain Three.js source of truth.
A read-only doctor, complete executable inventory, static network/subprocess audit, security policy, and least-privilege CI expose the executable and release boundary before use.

One network-free command executes six release gates, fails closed, bounds captured output, hashes full streams and declared proof inputs, and feeds a source-linked public Proof Lab without a private validation service.
Three code-native flagships carry committed artifact manifests, while Brick and Seoul additionally carry passing base-plus-variant production matrices.
